requiredEvidence: empty database migration to the candidate version
schema structure diff against the supported production shape
seed administrator and core review path validation
oldest supported version upgrade to the candidate version
decisionEvidence: application-prod.yml requires an externally supplied datasource
FlywayMigrationUpgradePathIntegrationTest verifies the V76 to V77 and V77 to V78 upgrade paths
baselinePolicy.reconsiderWhen: A V78 schema snapshot and all required rehearsal evidence are versioned together.
baselinePolicy.rollbackStrategy: restore a validated backup and apply a forward fix; never rewrite or delete a published migration

defaults.interruptedRecovery: retry after failed statement or apply a reviewed forward fix
defaults.rollbackStrategy: restore a validated backup and use a forward fix; no automatic DDL rollback

migrations.interruptedRecovery: restore the pre-tenancy backup and rerun the migration owner
migrations.rollbackStrategy: forward fix only after the tenant backfill is verified
migrations.compatibilityNote: historical tenancy bootstrap predates the expand-contract policy

migrations.interruptedRecovery: restore the validated pre-migration backup and rerun the migration owner
migrations.rollbackStrategy: forward fix after validating tenant ownership; no old-binary rollback
migrations.compatibilityNote: historical background-job migration replaced a legacy key before the expand-contract gate was introduced

migrations.interruptedRecovery: rerun the additive indexes; do not rewrite existing rows
migrations.rollbackStrategy: forward fix; retain additive keys until V77 contract completes

migrations.interruptedRecovery: stop writes, restore or repair dirty rows, then rerun the contract migration
migrations.rollbackStrategy: forward fix or restore the validated V77-predecessor backup; no old-binary rollback

migrations.estimatedRows: all tenants and tenant-owned singleton configuration rows
migrations.interruptedRecovery: repair missing or duplicate tenant configuration rows, then rerun the contract migration
migrations.rollbackStrategy: forward fix or restore the validated V78-predecessor backup; do not select an arbitrary duplicate
